The '''''Eternal Hope''''' was a [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]]. It was owned and operated by [[Trel Modetto]], an [[Outlaw tech/Legends|outlaw tech]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]]. Modetto stole the ''Eternal Hope'', using it as a base of operations which working as a smuggler, tech, [[Scout/Legends|scout]], and gunman.<ref name="MF">{{WEGCite|story=The Mecetti File|book=Tapani Sector Instant Adventures}}</ref>
